name: ATRIS
def: Four wheeled outdoor patrol robot used for security rounds at Chinese industrial parks and substations, carrying cameras, thermal imaging and lidar.
body: ATRIS is a heavy four wheeled outdoor patrol robot with a raised sensor head, built for perimeter and facility rounds in industrial settings. It drives mapped patrol routes autonomously, streaming panoramic and thermal video to a control room and flagging intruders, hotspots and anomalies. Operators can take manual control and speak through the robot. It is deployed at Chinese industrial parks, electrical substations and campuses, and a variant was used for temperature screening patrols during the COVID-19 pandemic.
facts: Used for outdoor security patrols at Chinese industrial parks and electrical substations
A pandemic variant carried thermal screening and public address equipment
Built by UBTECH Robotics of Shenzhen, which also produces humanoid and education robots
specs: Four wheeled electric drive chassis with a raised sensor mast
Lidar, panoramic cameras and thermal imaging
Autonomous patrol along mapped routes with remote operator handoff
